name: BrownLover~Kasshoku no Koibito~
source:
Girl with brown skin is trapped in a small room. She is going to experience lots a lots of love from her oppressor this day.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
棕色皮肤的女孩被困在一个小房间里。今天，她将从压迫者那里感受到很多很多的爱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
